metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a sciatic nerve release technique that may provide instant sciatica relief, often within 30 seconds.

This method targets tension along the sciatic nerve pathway, particularly in the glutes and piriformis muscle areas. It's especially effective for relieving deep gluteal syndrome and piriformis syndrome.

Give it a try and let us know your results!
